name: What precautions do I need to take after a professional urine cleanup service?

mainEntity.name: What precautions do I need to take after a professional urine cleanup service?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a professional urine cleanup service, it's important to allow adequate drying time for all treated areas. Avoid walking on damp carpets or furniture until they are completely dry to prevent re-soiling or damage. Maintain good ventilation in the cleaned areas to aid drying and dissipate any residual cleaner scents. Follow any specific post-cleanup instructions provided by the technicians, which may include avoiding direct sunlight or heavy foot traffic on certain surfaces for a period.
acceptedAnswer.description: Allow adequate drying time, avoid walking on damp areas, maintain good ventilation, and follow any specific instructions provided by the technicians.
